item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 04/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be persistently fine and dry over the coast of southern China over the weekend and early next week. It will be cool in the morning. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Temperatures over the region are expected to rise slightly in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 04/12 (Saturday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later.
Weather: Fine. Cool in the morning. Very dry during the day.
Temp range: 15 - 21 C
R.H. range: 35 - 65 per Cent
PSR: Low
